title: census.py dispatch fails on the real claude CLI: the result schema's $schema (2020-12) is rejected by --json-schema
goal: census_result.schema.json holds no $schema key (the test census_dispatch compares the passed text with the file, so it passes unchanged), so claude -p --json-schema takes it instead of failing with: no schema with key or ref https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema; every census.py dispatch run until then ends UNAPPLIED

run: import json,sys; sys.exit(1 if '$schema' in json.load(open('_tools/census_result.schema.json')) else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is a key in the schema file that the real claude CLI rejects; a repro may not run the real CLI (a paid call), and the suite's stub accepts any schema
